lines.en: -It's the gas station on Bennett Street?
-You know what? Why don't you stay and I'll go?
-Oh, no, no, no. I'll be fine.
-It's kind of a sketchy neighborhood, though.
Space Orphan and Princess Ninkum Poop
You drive. I got a car full of fox meat.
Who wrote captions under my doodle?
I'm not even kidding. They're pretty good.
-Well, the first one has a surprise factor.
-But I suppose the second one is the better written line.
-I'm supposed to be wearing red gloves,
but my color cartridge portal got jammed again.
-You guys, if I knew you wanted to do a caption contest,
I would have drawn something more challenging.
-And I will take you all down.
I've been reading the comics to my daughter
since she was three years old.
Not once have I used the real caption to "Family Circus."
That crazy family is hilarious to her for one reason: me.
-Oh, it is on like Genghis Khan wearing Sean John in Bhutan!
-You guys, I have the perfect idea, okay?
It'll just take me ten minutes.
-He answers to Michael, Michael G. Scott,
the incredible Mr. Fox. -Yeah, he just left.
-Okay. Hey, hey, hey, hey, let me answer this.
Stupid question, he went back to the office, obviously,
You don't think he walked by that bakery
just for the smell of it?
-Hey, hey, you guys, listen to me.
Don't get hung up on just one girl
because there are a lot of other girls out there.
I wish I could understand you.
-Do you think she needs more time
or is this never gonna happen?
-No, wait, um, hey, while you're out,
could you pick up some paper towels
We have ice cream, so I thought we could--
I just thought, since you're out--
-Pam, I'm obviously gonna get that stuff for you,
